normalisation.rule: One scale per five-character stamp; aspect ratio preserved; digits share a median vertical reference; colon retains its source position relative to the digits. A secondary stretched shape is used only as an auxiliary classifier feature.

classifier.type: mean distance of two nearest approved templates per label
classifier.time_decoder: minimum composite score among all valid 00:00-23:59 values

review_policy.score: maximum best-label distance across the four digits
review_policy.warning: The threshold is calibrated on leave-one-month-out data and must be rechecked with future cards.

scope_warning: This model evaluates recognition after a correct five-character crop. It does not measure product-side timestamp discovery or cropping.
